name: kerr-qnm-toolkit
description: Repo-backed Julia, Python, NumPy, SciPy, numerical, testing, source, and Git workflows for Kerr black-hole quasinormal-mode research in Codex Cloud.

interface.shortDescription: Repo-native Julia/Python tools for Kerr QNM solvers.
interface.longDescription: Develop, inspect, edit, run, test, and audit Kerr black-hole perturbation projects directly in Codex Cloud checkouts with Julia, CPython, NumPy, SciPy, cross-language protocol checks, a reproducible bundled toolchain, and Git-aware diagnostics. No MCP server or hosted compute service is required.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this Kerr QNM solver repository.
Run the local Julia-Python numerical canary.
Review, patch, and test this Julia and Python solver.
